purpose: Render the frozen 21-sample calibration set as a self-contained visual rating page so human reviewers can produce the 63-row manual ratings CSV the calibration gate requires.
bias_controls: no proxy readability scores in the page payload
sample order fixed to the reviewer template CSV
duplicate reviewer ids rejected for independent passes

decision.reason: Reviewers previously had only grid-genome JSON to look at; the calibration protocol is now executable by a human. Calibration itself stays blocked until the filled CSV exists and passes the gate.

next_research_step: Collect 3 independent reviewer passes with the tool, save the exported CSV to data/readability/slip_readability_calibration_ratings.csv, and rerun slip_readability_calibration_gate.py.
